QA-driven replacements and highest-value extensions only

globalConstraints: fixed orthographic side-on camera and crop
preserve exact player face, hair, clothing, backpack, proportions and shading
no ping-pong, reversed playback or backwards recovery
no rubber limbs, stretching, morphing, duplicate anatomy, texture crawl or flicker
silent with no text, logo, UI or watermark
background and floor stay registered to their opening pixels

calibration.label: Player walk loop source
calibration.prompt: Create a fixed-camera side-on game animation study of the exact supplied miner. Keep his face, hair, blue-gray clothing, gloves, shoes, backpack, body proportions, materials, lighting and scale unchanged. The supplied five-pose strip is motion guidance, while the first and last images are exact endpoint frames. Produce four continuous natural right-facing in-place walk cycles across eight seconds. Alternate planted feet with no foot skating; keep the pelvis, head and backpack coherent and the foot baseline fixed. Continue forward in time through the final-to-first boundary with no pause, rewind, reverse motion or ping-pong. The body must remain one articulated skeleton: no rubber limbs, morphing, extra anatomy, texture crawl, flicker or camera motion. Keep every magenta background pixel and the slate floor perfectly static. Silent. No text, UI, logo or watermark.

calibration.label: Player moving side-dig source
calibration.prompt: Create one forward-time fixed-camera side-on moving side-dig strike using the exact supplied miner and the five current-game poses as motion authority. Preserve his face, hair, blue-gray clothes, gloves, shoes, backpack, proportions, scale, materials and lighting exactly; add no tool or prop. Begin in the supplied running pose, drive the right arm to the authored straight contact pose near 1.35 seconds, carry the body and rear leg through a clean follow-through, then recover naturally into the supplied last frame by four seconds. Keep the contact hand attached, the torso solid, the feet grounded at contact and the baseline fixed. One strike only. No rubberbanding, stretching, morphing, duplicate limbs, flicker, texture crawl, pause, rewind, reverse motion, ping-pong or camera motion. Keep every magenta background pixel and the slate floor perfectly static. Silent. No text, UI, logo or watermark.

calibration.label: Soil contact aftereffect
calibration.prompt: Create one compact side-on game soil-impact aftereffect on the exact locked plate. Keep the dirt tile, black field, ground edge, camera, crop and exposure completely static. Hold clean for the first 0.45 seconds. At 0.8 seconds, strike the upper-left face of the dirt tile with one crisp localized impact: six to ten irregular brown soil chips, a low dense dust cone, two tiny pebble arcs and a short warm contact flash. Fragments follow gravity forward and down, decelerate, settle or leave frame, and fully clear by 3.25 seconds so the last frame exactly matches the supplied clean plate. One burst only. No looping, reverse playback, ping-pong, suction back to origin, morphing, flicker, smoke billboards, player, hand, tool, text, logo, UI, watermark or camera motion. Silent.
